about: Where an order stands, stage by stage, and who the next step waits on (21 Nov 2026). Manager Approval -> GM Approval (escalated orders only) -> SAP Order Creation -> Pick List Generation -> Order Processing. Each stage is done, current, waiting, na (not applicable) or unknown. Read only from fields the apps, the SAP order sync and B1if already write; nothing is inferred.
why: The GM and the sales managers asked for each order's real status: which SAP holds it, how far it has gone, and who has to act. A guessed stage is worse than none, so a stage is done only when a field says so, and an empty or unreadable field gives unknown or waiting. Implemented in client/src/domain/orderTrack.ts. The phone does not show this track yet; when it does, its implementation must load these cases.

the_shape.order: Raw Sales Order fields: custom_po_status, custom_gm_approved_by, custom_gm_approved_on, custom_mt_sales_order (Manna Treads SAP DocNum, PASS M), custom_mt_sync_error, custom_mt_invoice, custom_sap_sales_order (Hi-Tech SAP DocNum, PASS A or PASS H), custom_sap_sales_order_status, custom_sap_order_status (B1iF), custom_sap_invoice, custom_sap_sync_error.
the_shape.pick_lists: The order's Manna Pick Lists as manna_pick_lists returns them, or null when they could not be read.
the_shape.today: The server's date. Absent: the pick-list window is not applied.
the_shape.pick_lists_since: Manna App Settings.pick_lists_since. Absent or '': every order gets a pick list.
the_shape.expect.stages: States in order: manager, gm, sap, pick, processing.
the_shape.expect.sap: Which SAP holds the order: the DocNum in each, '' when that SAP does not have it.
the_shape.expect.who: Who the next step waits on: rep, sales_manager, gm, office (the office and SAP: the sync, B1if, Hi-Tech's store), or null when nothing waits.
the_shape.expect.outcome: open, complete (invoiced), cancelled (in SAP) or rejected.

rules.which_sap: custom_mt_sales_order is Manna Treads SAP; custom_sap_sales_order is Hi-Tech SAP. An order on the Manna Treads first route has both once B1if has made Hi-Tech's order. Neither is derived from the other or from custom_company.
rules.gm_only_when_recorded: GM Approval applies when the order is at Pending GM Approval or Pending Final Approval, or carries custom_gm_approved_by. An approved order with no GM stamp is na ('No GM approval on record'); a rejected one is unknown, because nothing records whether it reached the GM.
rules.in_sap_is_a_fact_whatever_the_approval: Until 19 Nov 2026 PASS M sent an order to Manna Treads SAP before approval, so an order still with the manager can already be in SAP. The SAP stage says so; the next step is still the approval.
rules.pick_list_needs_hitech: A pick list goes against Hi-Tech's sales order, so without custom_sap_sales_order the pick-list stage waits, and the next step is the office's (B1if), not the rep's.
rules.the_pick_list_window: A pick list opens two days before the order's delivery_date and only for orders placed from pick_lists_since (pick_list_window.json, enforced by manna_pick_list_submit). Before the window the stage waits and says the day it opens; an order older than the start date gets none, and the next step is not the rep's.
rules.production_approval_is_not_a_step: Since 9 Nov 2026 the sync no longer reads a pick list's approval_status; Hi-Tech's store confirms the list in SAP. Shown, never waited on.
rules.unread_pick_lists_are_unknown: When pick lists could not be read, or the read may not hold this order's (the endpoint returns the newest 200), the stage is unknown, never 'no pick list'.
rules.done_means_invoiced: Order Processing is done only on custom_sap_invoice, custom_mt_invoice or B1iF's custom_sap_order_status = Dispatched - each an invoice for the whole order. A delivery is not dispatch (sap_order_state.json).
rules.never_in_sap_before_approval: The user's rule (23 Nov 2026): nothing goes to SAP until the manager - and the GM, when escalated - has approved, i.e. custom_po_status is 'PO Approved - Ready for SAP'. An order SAP has while it is at any other status was sent early by the order sync; expect.early_sap says so and the screens show it as a warning. Its pick list waits for approval, because manna_pick_list_submit refuses one before it. The user's call, 24 Nov 2026: such an order (unless rejected) shows its Manager and GM steps as passed, since SAP is past them, with ERPNext's status in the note and the warning kept; the next step is the approval in ERPNext the pick list needs.
rules.cancelled_ends_it: bost_Cancelled in custom_sap_sales_order_status, or Cancelled in custom_sap_order_status, ends the order: the later stages are na and nothing waits on anyone.

pick_lists_by_order.why: a read shorter than the limit is complete: an order with no lists has none
a read that hit the limit may be missing older lists: an order not in it is not known
a failed read: every order not known
